column12: Sabotage and disruption of industrial control and communications capabilities
column13: Access to internal networks of grid connection points; original entry method not established in the available evidence
column14: CERT Polska reports reconnaissance and destructive actions involving controller firmware damage, deletion of system files and custom wiper malware; RTU damage disrupted communications with the distribution system operator and prevented remote control. Dragos additionally reports disabled communications equipment including OT devices, based partly on incident-response involvement at one affected site; insufficient logging prevents determination of whether operational commands were attempted.
column15: Loss of remote communication and control capabilities and damage to communications or OT equipment; ongoing electricity generation was not interrupted. Hypothetical generation losses and grid-frequency consequences discussed by Dragos were not observed incident impacts.
column20: Grouped record covering more than 30 installations; individual compromise timelines and operators are not enumerated. Dragos reports direct incident-response involvement at one affected site, and its observations cannot automatically be generalised across all installations. Underlying ELECTRUM attribution indicators and independence from CERT Polska investigative evidence are not established. OT command logging was insufficient to determine the full extent of attempted equipment manipulation. Exact initial access remains unresolved.
column21: Part of the coordinated 29 December 2025 Polish attacks; related cases are recorded separately as INC-003 and INC-004. CERT Polska SRC-006 and Dragos SRC-019/SRC-020 provide distinct attribution assessments, but the two Dragos publications are not independent corroboration. CLM-019 records the Dragos ELECTRUM assessment without establishing responsibility at every affected installation. TTP-002 remains a provisional analyst mapping to ATT&CK for ICS Data Destruction based on CLM-005; device-specific validation remains outstanding. No additional ATT&CK mapping assigned.
